annotations.title: All FX pairs, forex cross rates

description: All FX pairs in one call: cross rates for every pair among the major currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, CNY) or up to 12 chosen ones, from the European Central Bank's daily reference rates, with the date they apply to. Use to fill a forex rate table, convert between many currencies at once, or check a cross rate. Reference mid rates, not live bid/ask. Example: currencies=USD,EUR,GBP. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

currencies.description: Optional comma-separated currency codes (2-12); default the eight majors
